capabilities: Log workout sets with user-defined types, fields, and units
Render workout-log, workout-day, workout-plan, and workout-heatmap code blocks
Define derived stats with a guided builder or free expressions
Build training plans with per-set targets and flexible schedules
Map muscles to anatomy SVG paths and color a full-body heatmap
extras: Not yet in the official community store ("not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff"); installed via BRAT or manual file placement. Ships a bundled CLI (workout-block-record) for logging and querying data from a terminal.
motivation: Most training apps hard-code fields, exercises, and plans, forcing you to adapt to them; this plugin gives the "definition power" back to the user.
problem: Obsidian has no workout tracking, and most training apps hard-code fields, exercise libraries, and plan templates, forcing users to adapt to preset structures.

relations.evidence: directly queryable by tools like Dataview
medical anatomical naming, from flutter-body-atlas, CC BY 4.0

summary: Customizable workout tracker that logs sets as plain CSV, renders log/plan/heatmap code blocks, computes user-defined derived stats, and maps muscles on anatomy SVGs.
